parameters.name: payoutMerchantId
parameters.description: Specify the merchant ID provided while onboarding for Payouts in this parameter.

transferStatus.description: Search by status of transfer. Merchant can get all success or failure transaction of the day to reconcile. The transfer status can be any of the following: - QUEUED/SCHEDULED - IN_PROGRESS - PENDING - FAILED

from.description: Specify the date from when transfer status is required in this field. The format of the date must be in DD/MM/YY format.

to.description: Specify the date up to which the transfer status required in this field. The format of the date must be in DD/MM/YY format.

page.description: Specify the page number in this field. By default, the value is 1.

pageSize.description: Specify the page size. The maximum is 1000.

merchantRefId.description: Indicates a unique reference ID at the merchant side to distinguish between multiple transfers.

batchId.description: It can be any string value. Merchants can use this value if they want to process the request in batch and also what status of transfer in batch. This can be unique for a batch or across multiple requests.

parameters.name: payoutmerchantid
parameters.description: Specify the merchant ID provided while onboarding for Payouts in this parameter.

queueTxn.description: Specify whether to add a transaction in the Queued status or not.

configMerchantId.description: Specify the Payout merchantId in this parameter.

parameters.name: ifsc
parameters.description: Indicates the IFSC Code of the bank to fetch the associated beneficiary details

parameters.name: ifscCode
parameters.description: Specify the IFSC Code of the Bank Account

parameters.name: merchantRefId
parameters.description: Specify the unique identifier from merchant to identify the status

parameters.name: validateIfsc
parameters.description: Select the flag as true or false to validate IFSC or not respectively.

parameters.name: nameMatching
parameters.description: Select the flag as True to check name matching.

parameters.name: amount
parameters.description: Specify the amount to be submitted for penny drop transaction.

BODYOBJECT.title: BODYOBJECT

beneficiaryAccountNumber.description: Indicates beneficiary account number to transfer money. Required for IMPS, NEFT and RTGS paymentType.

beneficiaryIfscCode.description: Indicates IFSC Code of the Beneficiary Bank Account. Required for IMPS, NEFT and RTGS paymentType.

beneficiaryName.description: Indicates name of the Beneficiary of the the beneficiary associated with Bank Account. Required for PHONE

beneficiaryMobile.description: Indicates the beneficiary mobile number. Required for PHONE paymentType

purpose.description: This parameter must include the purpose of doing this transfer.

amount.description: Indicates amount to transfer to the beneficiary account.

batchId.description: It can be any string value. Merchants can use this value if they want to process the request in batch and also what status of transfer in batch. This can be unique for a batch or across multiple requests.

merchantRefId.description: Indicates a unique reference ID at the merchant side to distinguish between multiple transfers.

paymentType.description: Specify the mode of payment in this field. It can be any of the following: - IMPS - UPI - NEFT - RTGS - PHONE

recipientCardNo.description: The Credit Card Number with which the payment is made by your customer is specified in this field.

disableApprovalFlow.description: If this field is set to True, the approval flow process for the specific payout transaction is skipped or disabled..

retry.description: Specify the flag as either True or False to indicate whether to retry transfer or not in this field.
